items.title: Automatically recover from GPU failures with Amazon ECS Managed Instances
items.summary: Amazon ECS Managed Instances provides built-in GPU health monitoring and automatic repair powered by NVIDIA DCGM. This post shows how GPU auto-repair detects critical GPU hardware failures and replaces impaired instances with no code changes, and how to observe and safely validate the workflow using DCGM fault injection on a dual-tier inference pipeline.
items.creator: Piyush Mattoo
